books.title: Mindful Self-Compassion for Burnout: Tools to Help You Heal and Recharge When You're Wrung Out by Stress
books.author: Kristin Neff, Christopher Germer
books.description: Written with Kristin Neff for people worn down by work and caring for others. Each chapter tells the story of someone stretched to their limit, then offers a short practice drawn from the Mindful Self-Compassion programme.

left_out: Mindfulness and Psychotherapy; Wisdom and Compassion in Psychotherapy: professional psychotherapy texts, left out under the therapy scope rule (not the health rule).
Mindful Self-Compassion for Burnout video: videos are handled separately.
